expected_behavior: The county-name-assessor-data-access-58.csv note ('TDLS 164, dated March 31 2026, not yet opened') implied an upcoming/current sale to build pre-auction dossiers against.
observed_behavior: TDLS164's sale actually ran March 20-31, 2026, which is already in the past as of this session (2026-08-08). Cross-referencing the full 311-parcel non-redeemed list against the live recorder showed 178 of 311 (57%) had already sold (Deed Tax recorded) and 111 of 311 (36%) had been redeemed (Release of Lien recorded) since the list was published -- only 17 of 311 (5%) remained genuinely still tax-defaulted with no release or sale-deed found. No next sale (TDLS165) has been published by Lake County yet.
impact: Using the TDLS164 list at face value without a live per-parcel recorder recheck would have produced dossiers that were wrong (redeemed or already sold) for 93% of parcels on the list -- a direct repeat of the kind of trust failure this pipeline already suffered once.
current_handling: Resolved by building a real recorder-based lien-lifecycle classifier (lake/lake_recorder_lien_check.py) and only shipping the 16 (of 17, minus the one discrepancy above) parcels with live, dated recorder evidence of an unreleased, unsold tax lien. signal_priority.get_signal('lake') was left untouched (not modified, not overridden) -- it correctly falls through to the shared NO_SCHEDULED_AUCTION / 'No scheduled auction -- monitor for a future sale date' signal since lake is not in AUCTION_CALENDAR.
evidence_reference: lake/lake_TDLS164_parsed.csv (311 parcels), lake/lake_lien_classification_ALL.json (full 311-parcel classification: 178 sold, 111 redeemed, 17 still-defaulted, 5 no activity found), lake/lake_still_defaulted_full.csv
next_action: When Lake publishes its next tax sale list (watch lakecountyca.gov/1109/Tax-Collector for a TDLS165 entry), re-run this same recorder-lien-lifecycle methodology against the new list; also worth periodically rechecking the 16 shipped APNs since Lake's cadence shows redemptions/lien releases continuing to post for months after a nominal sale date.
